request.style: English, female solo voice with choir, harp, cello, piano, strings, ethereal pads, majestic and hopeful, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Ever since I heard your faith in Christ
And love for all the saints
I have not stopped giving thanks
Remembering you in my prayers

[Chorus]
Eyes of your heart may be enlightened
Knowing the hope of his calling
Riches of his glorious inheritance
Among the saints

[Verse]
A spirit of wisdom and revelation
In the knowledge of him
The God of our Lord Jesus Christ
The Father of glory

[Chorus]
Eyes of your heart may be enlightened
Knowing the hope of his calling
Riches of his glorious inheritance
Among the saints

[Bridge]
Surpassingly great is his power
Toward us who believe
According to the working
Of his mighty strength

[Outro]
He raised him from the dead
Seated at his right hand
